For the yield estimation task, alongside range sensors ( e.g., LIDAR or lasers), there is increasing adoption of vision-based methods (mostly based on CNNs) that are very effective also in unstructured or partially unstructured environments. A modern vision-based yield estimation approach is a complex system capable to detect, track and map the fruits collecting streams of images.
